decision_use: descriptive_evidence_only; no scoring, thresholds, grades, or investment recommendation

period.annual_as_of_rule: use AsOfQuery.get_latest_available() at each annual-report availability date
period.available_at_rule: max(all direct and expanded derived inputs)
period.future_fact_rule: a fact is not eligible before its available_at

restatement_policy.revision_rule: a changed eligible fact creates a new metric version and supersedes the prior version
restatement_policy.unchanged_rule: unchanged annual input does not create a synthetic metric version
restatement_policy.missing_rule: missing is explicit and never coerced to zero
restatement_policy.comparability_rule: negative denominators are not comparable when the method says so

blockers: annual CAS consolidated eligible coverage must be proven before computation

component_policy.required: all five direct mutually exclusive components
component_policy.duplicate_policy: current and long-term portions must not be counted twice
component_policy.unavailable_split: blocked; do not infer from total_liabilities

blockers: current portion direct official fact is not yet proven in the minimum foundation

cash_policy.canonical: period-end cash_and_cash_equivalents from the cash-flow statement
cash_policy.allowed_explicit_proxy: monetary_funds only when the filing explicitly identifies it as the comparable cash proxy
cash_policy.restricted_cash: not canonical unless a separate contract proves comparability

blockers: canonical cash statement line and direct gross-debt foundation require evidence

status_rules.negative_result: computed_and_displayed; do not clamp to zero

methods.display_policy: always disclose gross debt and canonical cash beside net debt
blockers: same as gross debt and canonical cash foundation

status_rules.reason: interest expense capitalization, expense recognition, cash-paid boundary, and numerator are not uniquely evidenced
status_rules.forbidden_guess: do not use operating_profit or finance_expense as an uncontracted proxy

references.borrow: separate source-provider mapping from a stable canonical model
references.apply_to: input concept mapping and validation boundary
references.not_copy: no provider, API, network, or automatic source-priority layer

references.borrow: keep reported statement inputs and derived metric formulas transparent
references.not_copy: no provider normalization, fiscal-year conversion, or unverified ratio vocabulary

references.borrow: distinguish fact, context, unit, instant, and duration
references.not_copy: no full XBRL processor or taxonomy engine

references.borrow: named deterministic validation rules with explicit failure semantics
references.apply_to: input contract and future checkpoint rule IDs
references.not_copy: no dependency or opaque framework migration

references.not_copy: no external checkpoint store or runtime dependency in this stage
